text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Croatian President Tudjman brings Croats back to Vukovar in a symbolic train journey.
- Petrol prices may go slightly down, but natural gas prices expected to rise.
- Attacked opposition presidential candidate Vlado Gotovac released from hospital and feeling somewhat better.

- The sale of new cars has soared at the start of 1997 due to loans that are being offered. Some 15,168 cars have been sold in the first five months of 1997 in comparison to 14,773 in the whole of 1995.
- It's wonderful to win the Roland Garros, says the Croatian tennis star Iva Majoli in an interview.
- The state and hoteliers have not considered the need to import the necessary amounts of meat for the upcoming tourist season, a move that might backfire. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
